about: Reviewed exceptions to the pip-audit gate (scripts/ci/pip_audit_gate.py, tests.yml `audit`). Each entry: id (the advisory id or any alias, e.g. a CVE), package, reason (why it does not apply here or cannot be fixed yet), expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 180 days ahead). An expired or malformed entry fails the gate; the fix is a pin bump or a renewed, re-reasoned entry.

entries.reason: Applies: the bot's HTTPS downloads (requests, curl_cffi) trust certifi's bundle, which still holds the emSign ECC Root CA - G3 root whose intermediates had their keys compromised. Not fixed in the change that added the hashes, which kept every pin; the fix (2026.10.18) is inside the repo's 14-day release cooldown until 2026-11-01. Bump certifi then and delete this entry.

No code in this repository imports filelock; it is installed as a torch dependency. The advisories are in its SQLite-backed ReadWriteLock/AsyncReadWriteLock and (two of three, Windows only) its soft locks, which nothing here uses; CI and the bot run on Linux. Fixed in 4.2.1 (a major-version bump of a torch dependency): take it in a reviewed lock recompile.

No code in this repository imports filelock, and nothing here calls the torch paths that lock files (hub downloads, compile caches); it is installed as a torch dependency. The advisory is in StrictSoftFileLock (a symbolic link swapped in at <path>.filelock) and needs another local user who can create names in the lock directory. CI and the bot run on single-user, ephemeral GitHub runners. Fixed in 4.2.1 (a major-version bump of a torch dependency): take it in a reviewed lock recompile.

Fixed in 4.2.1 (a major-version bump of a torch dependency): take it in a reviewed lock recompile.

The advisory is in StrictSoftFileLock (claim directories created without the lock mode) and needs another local user with a write bit on them. CI and the bot run on single-user, ephemeral GitHub runners. Fixed in 4.2.1 (a major-version bump of a torch dependency): take it in a reviewed lock recompile.

Windows only: the legacy wheel-to-egg install path. Nothing here installs with setuptools (pip installs the hashed lock) and CI and the bot run on Linux; setuptools is in the lock as a torch dependency. Fixed in 84.1.0: take it in a reviewed lock recompile.
